description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans Membership Table implementation using Azure Storage. It verifies operations such as initialization, gateway retrieval, reading, inserting, updating, and heartbeat updates of the Azure-based membership table, ensuring correct behavior with Azure Table Storage.

classes.name: AzureMembershipTableTests
classes.description: Unit test class for Azure-based Orleans Membership Table operations, including setup, insertion, reading, updating, and heartbeat tests.
